data: Is the blue line always decreasing?

Wait a moment, does it seem right? The caption mentions that the blue line represents the baseline grammar of one production rule for each message. From the graph, I can see that the blue line starts at approximately 50,000 and decreases slightly before reaching its lowest point around 4000, where it remains relatively stable. After this point, there is no clear indication of further decrease in the blue line. Therefore, the blue line is not always decreasing.
